messages:
Alex W: Quick sync — kicking off priority triage for citrine-13b onboarding. Need decisions on quant path (8-bit vs 4-bit), canary schedule, and whether to prioritize NLU or long-form generation use cases. Sample evals look good but we saw regressions on some math QA prompts.
Priya S: Can you attach the eval snapshot? main things I care about: Rouge/EM delta, hallucination checks, and latency at 2048 tokens.
Alex W: Pasted the short summary below from the eval harness run (full artifacts in GCS):
- Rouge-L: -0.03 vs baseline
- EM: -0.02 (mainly on arithmetic QA)
- Latency: +18% at 2048 tokens on p4d-8x
- Memory: fits 13B in 8-bit; 4-bit needs kernel fixes
- Qual: better summarization coherence on docs
Jordan K: Given +18% latency, infra impact is non-trivial. If we can quantize to 4-bit safely we might recover perf; otherwise this goes into medium priority unless roadmap requires it.
Marta L: Infra note: Dedicated pool is ~70% booked next month. We can carve a canary slot for 48h if we limit qps to 5 rps for the canary route.
Cheng Z: From quant experiments: 8-bit works out-of-the-box with minimal NLL drift. 4-bit (nf4) drops some arithmetic accuracy further. My suggestion: start with 8-bit + activation aware caching, run a focused regression suite on arithmetic prompts.
Priya S: For prioritization scoring, propose we use a compact rubric — keeps things objective:
Score = round(100 * (0.35 * QualityDeltaScore + 0.25 * LatencyImpactScore + 0.2 * QuantRiskScore + 0.2 * RoadmapFitScore))
where each subscore is normalized 0..1 (higher better). QualityDeltaScore penalizes >2% EM drop.
Jordan K: Sounds good. If we plug current numbers: QualityDeltaScore=0.85, LatencyImpactScore=0.6, QuantRiskScore=0.8, RoadmapFitScore=0.7 => Score ~ 74 => medium-high.
Alex W: OK medium-high. Proposed next steps:
- Cheng: run focused arithmetic regression with 8-bit and nf4 for comparators (2k prompts) — due EOD +2.
- Priya: run canary gating checklist and prepare the canary route config (limit, time window) — due EOD +3.
- Marta: reserve the 48h dedicated slot and set autoscaler to prevent burst >10 rps — due EOD +3.
- Jordan: update scoring sheet and mark citrine-13b as "canary-ready" if regressions <1.5% EM — due EOD +3.
Cheng Z: I'll start the quant runs now. Quick note: include beam-size=1 in gen to match production — I saw differences when beam=4.
Eva-bot: CI summary for citrine-13b prereq tests: all unit tests passed; docker build completed (sha: 7f3b2a); baseline smoke checks: 1 failure (math-regex-case). See: https://ci.internal/runs/2098765
Priya S: If the arithmetic regression persists after 8-bit we'll consider targeted prompt filters or a light calibration head before pushing to canary. Need a short playbook in the canary checklist for rollback triggers (e.g., EM drop >1.5% or latency increase >25%).
Alex W: Agreed. Let's reconvene in 48h for a quick status. If Cheng finds nf4 safe and latency improves, we'll escalate to high priority for rollout. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jordan K: +1. Adding to weekly model review agenda.
Marta L: Noted and reserving slot now.
Cheng Z: On it.
Priya S: Will draft the canary checklist and post here when ready.
Alex W: End sync.
